title: Glimpsing archaeal microbes on the move
title_zh: 窥视古细菌微生物的运动
abstract: How and when did cells gain the ability to crawl? Live imaging of cells from close relatives of early eukaryotes fills in a major gap in the understanding of cellular evolution.
abstract_zh: 细胞如何以及何时获得爬行能力？对早期真核生物近亲细胞的实时成像，填补了细胞进化理解中的一个重大空白。
